name: Ou-sama no Chou
source:
It came about that Uka was introduced to the prince by his royal sorcerer. ------His lover. 

For one year. Magic temporarily transformed the butterfly prince. But as a promise, that same magic was a curse which would not allow him to regress. 

The prince made many requests of his sorcerer, his hired "butterfly". It was a year of honesty and peaceful love for Uka. And then, the day came......?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE102175.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
乌卡被王子的皇家巫师介绍给王子。------他的爱人。

一年了。魔法暂时改变了蝴蝶王子。但作为承诺，同样的魔法也是一个诅咒，不允许他退步。

王子向他的巫师、他雇佣的“蝴蝶”提出了许多要求。对于乌卡来说，这是诚实和平爱的一年。然后，这一天到来了……？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE102175.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
